  Allow you to create contact - contact , contact - custom objects and business - contact associations, will add more in the future.Documentation Link - https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-2937...
- `associations.create-relation` — **Create Relation for you associated entities.** — `POST /associations/relations` (write, location)

- `associations.delete-association` — **Delete Association** — `DELETE /associations/{associationId}` (write, location)

- `associations.delete-relation` — **Delete Relation** — `DELETE /associations/relations/{relationId}` (write, location)
- `associations.find-associations` — **Get all associations for a sub-account / location** — `GET /associations/` (read, location)

- `associations.get-association-by-id` — **Get association by ID** — `GET /associations/{associationId}` (read, location)

- `associations.get-association-key-by-key-name` — **Get association key by key name** — `GET /associations/key/{key_name}` (read, location)
